messageHandlers.script:
system.perspective.print("deleteChkEvent message received with %s"%payload)
	self.deleteChkEvent()	
	
	return

system.perspective.print("chkEventsChanged() msg rcvd with " + str(payload))
	
	#If the filter is set to only look for auto-scheduled checks, we'll set it to false
	#so the new manual check shows up and that in turn will force the data binding to update
	#otherwise we will trigger the auto-update
	if self.view.custom.filters.auto == 1: 
		self.view.custom.filters.auto = 0
	else:
		self.view.custom.autoUpdate.enabled = True

	return

system.perspective.print("chkShtEventEditor message received with %s"%payload)

	self.view.custom.table.selection.col = None
	self.view.custom.table.selection.row = None
	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.table.data")
	self.view.custom.edit.chkShtEventId = None

	return

system.perspective.print("chkShtEventAdded() msg rcvd with " + str(payload))
